newsitem.title: LATVIA: Valmiera powers ahead as Latvian stocks active.
newsitem.headline: Valmiera powers ahead as Latvian stocks active.

text.p: Latvian shares maintained high volumes although turnover slipped on Tuesday with bourse newcomer Valmiera Glassfibre powering ahead, dealers said.
Total market turnover came to 276,000 lats versus 281,000 lats and the Rietumu Bank index rose by 0.37 percent to 184.54.
Secondary list share, Valmiera, jumped 33 santimes to 2.53 lats on volume of 76,100 lats, the highest in today's trade.
Valmiera was first quoted on the Latvian bourse on Monday, when it rose to 2.20 lats, well above its nominal price of one lats.
Leading official list share Unibanka, which pursued gains in recent sessions, slowed down slightly, putting on just one santime to 4.50 lats. It turned over 70,200 lats.
Daugavpils Chain, usual secondary list leader, slipped slightly to 2.63 from 2.65 lats on volume of 33,100 lats.
Among fish canneries, Kaija had volume of 15,700 lats and rose three santimes to 2.28 lats and Roja saw trade of 11,500 lats, remaining stable at 3.00 lats.
Salacgriva 95 put on 20 santimes to 5.00 lats on volume of 5,300 lats.
Elsewhere on the official list, Staburadze confectionery advanced 13 santimes to 2.93 lats and turned over 18,300 lats while Riga Transport Fleet was stable at 1.70 lats on volume of 19,200 lats.
